name: Civic Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public civic and government data.

entries.title: Census Bureau Voting and Registration (CPS November Supplement)
entries.description: The Census Bureau's estimates of voter registration and turnout among U.S. citizens by age, sex, race, education, and other characteristics, from the Current Population Survey's November supplement in every national election since 1964.
entries.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, Current Population Survey, Voting and Registration Supplement
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page says "For every national election since 1964, we collected data on the characteristics of American voters". The tables page lists "Voting and Registration in the Election of November 2024" (April 2025). It notes "The P20 detailed tables are released every two years following national level elections" and that tables come in XLS, CSV, and PDF. Releases follow the two-year election cycle; the schema has no biennial value, so cadence is irregular.

entries.title: Congress.gov API
entries.description: The Library of Congress's public API for U.S. legislative data from Congress.gov — bills, amendments, actions, members, committees, congressional records, and more.

coverage.temporal: multiple Congresses (coverage varies by data type)

entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200 for api.congress.gov. It says "Congress.gov shares its application programming interface (API) with the public" and asks users to "Sign up for an API key from api.data.gov". It documents /v3 endpoints such as GET /bill. The www.congress.gov web site returned 403 (bot protection) to curl this session; civic-almanac runs the headless checker. Two things come from the API's usual documentation and weren't checked: the daily update cadence and the xml format option.

entries.title: EAC Election Administration & Voting Survey (EAVS)
entries.description: The U.S. Election Assistance Commission's biennial survey of how elections are administered nationwide — registration, turnout, mail ballots, polling places, and election technology.
entries.notes: Conducted after each federal general election (biennial).

entries.title: European Parliament Election Results 2024
entries.description: The European Parliament's official results site for the 2024 European elections: results by country and political group, seat distribution, and turnout, with the constitutive session composition.

coverage.temporal: 2024 European elections (with historical results back to 1979 on the site)

entries.license: unverified — European Parliament legal notice not checked this session
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200 (redirects to /en/). The disclaimer reads "The final update to data on this website took place on 6 September 2024", which is a publisher declaration that the data is static, so status is frozen. For the current composition of political groups, the site points to the MEPs section of the EP website. Three things weren't checked: the historical results back to 1979, the download formats, and the license.

entries.title: FEC Campaign Finance Data
entries.description: The Federal Election Commission's data on money raised and spent in US federal elections — candidate, committee, and individual contribution records, with an open API.
entries.notes: Open API at api.open.fec.gov; bulk data downloads available.

entries.title: Federal Register
entries.description: The daily journal of the US federal government — proposed and final rules, notices, and presidential documents from federal agencies, with a full open API.
entries.publisher: Office of the Federal Register (National Archives) and the Government Publishing Office
entries.attribution: Office of the Federal Register / GPO

entries.title: U.S. GAO Reports & Recommendations
entries.description: Reports, testimonies, and open recommendations from the Government Accountability Office — Congress's nonpartisan audit and oversight arm.
entries.notes: gao.gov 403s non-browser agents — the checker retries with a browser UA.

entries.title: GovInfo (GPO)
entries.description: The Government Publishing Office's repository of authenticated federal publications — the Federal Register, US Code, Code of Federal Regulations, congressional documents, and more.
entries.notes: Bulk data and a public API.

entries.title: International IDEA Voter Turnout Database
entries.description: The most comprehensive global collection of voter turnout statistics for presidential and parliamentary elections since 1945, plus European Parliament elections, using both registered voters and voting-age population as bases.
entries.publisher: International Institute for Democracy and Electoral Assistance (International IDEA)

access.auth_note: Export may require accepting International IDEA's release agreement.

entries.license: © International IDEA, all rights reserved; use governed by IDEA's terms and data release agreement
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page calls it "the most comprehensive global collection of voter turnout statistics from presidential and parliamentary elections since 1945", including European Parliament elections, with an "Export data" option. The footer reads "© 2026 International IDEA. All Rights Reserved" and links a "Release Agreement Form", so this is not open-licensed. It is cataloged for authority; reusers should read IDEA's terms. Jurisdiction is multilateral because International IDEA is an intergovernmental organization of member states. The export formats and the release-agreement requirement weren't checked.

entries.title: National Archives Catalog
entries.description: Online catalog of the holdings of the U.S. National Archives (NARA) — archival descriptions, authority records, digitized records, and public contributions, with a read/write API.
entries.publisher: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration (NARA)

access.auth_note: Catalog API requires a free API key (x-api-key header); web and bulk access do not

entries.attribution: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration (NARA)
entries.notes: Catalog API v2, docs at archives.gov/research/catalog/help/api. Requires requesting an API key. Full catalog dataset on AWS Open Data (biannual): registry.opendata.aws/nara-national-archives-catalog

entries.title: USAspending.gov
entries.description: The official open-data source for US federal spending — awards, contracts, grants, loans, and agency budgetary resources, with a full public API.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service
entries.attribution: USAspending.gov, U.S. Department of the Treasury
entries.notes: Open REST API (api.usaspending.gov); bulk award archives available.
